Name: No More Robin - Build It Yourself
Author: soda5cm
Description:
Don't wait for Robin — grab a hammer and build your farm yourself!

[b]No More Robin[/b] adds a [b]Construction[/b] tab to the game menu (E). From there you can build any of Robin's buildings, upgrade them, and upgrade your house — without paying gold and without waiting for Robin. You build them with your own hands.

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Open the menu ([b]E[/b]) → the new [b]Construction[/b] tab (house icon, right after Crafting).[/*]
[*]Pick a building. The tooltip shows the materials you have and need, the number of work days, and a description. Faded icons mean you don't have enough materials yet.[/*]
[*]Click it and place the building on your farm, just like at Robin's. The construction site is set up.[/*]
[*]Buy a [b]Builder's Hammer[/b] from Robin (1000g, once). It's a real tool, like the pickaxe or axe.[/*]
[*]Hit the construction site with the hammer: [b]10 hits = 1 work day[/b] (4 energy per hit). Do this on as many days as the building needs.[/*]
[*]When the last work day is done, the building is finished overnight.[/*]
[/list]
Skipping a day is fine: the site simply waits for you.

[size=4][b]Costs[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]No gold[/b] at all.[/*]
[*]Instead you need [b]2× the materials[/b] Robin would use…[/*]
[*]…but every [b]Farming level[/b] gives you [b]−5% materials[/b] (up to −50% at level 10).[/*]
[/list]
House upgrades (×2 and the Farming discount apply):

Upgrade — Base materials
1 — kitchen & bedroom — 450 Wood
2 — nursery — 100 Hardwood
3 — cellar — 150 Hardwood + 10 Gold Bars

The tooltip explains what each house upgrade adds.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Several construction sites at the same time.[/*]
[*]Progress bar for active sites in the tab and a label above each site on the farm.[/*]
[*]Robin still works as usual if you'd rather pay gold.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] the host starts construction (including house upgrades for every farmhand's cabin), and everyone can help with the hammer. [b]All players need the mod installed.[/b][/*]
[*]All numbers can be changed in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional): material multiplier, discount per Farming level, hits per work day, energy per hit, hammer price.[/*]
[*]Translated into 12 languages: English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Turkish, Chinese.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0 or newer).[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+[/b]. Safe to add to an existing save. Before removing the mod, finish all active construction sites and sell or trash the Builder's Hammer.
